featured_reviews.name: Ora Pat
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is my second review to COPAIN SAVE MART in the last 3 years.
Unfortunately my review has not gotten worse with time.
Dear viewers, this is an absolute honest detailed experience with this mart.

1.  It isn’t a “save” mart at all. Prices are higher than market and they sell expensive local things under the tag of “imported”.

2. This is my second purchase of Puff pastry sheets from this mart. We have used these sheets all life. Never found this cheap version ever. All waste. When I took them back to the store, the short lady on the counter said that you probably don’t know how to use them!!. All sheets were melted refrozen and sold hence none of the sheets came out right.

3. Arrogance: I understand that there aren’t many competitive stores around you but this arrogance will definitely take this store down. Specially pointing at the counter lady. Im sure many of you can relate to this.

Dear Copain save mart, if you all think you can fool your customers and pull money from them in the name of selling expired or spoiled products, do remember Karma for once.

featured_reviews.name: QAYNAAT ZARA
featured_reviews.review_text:
Copain Save Mart is one of the best gourmet and grocery stores in Mumbai. The variety is outstanding — from premium dry fruits and imported chocolates to fresh cheese, and specialty items, they have everything under one roof. The store is clean, well-organized, and always stocked with unique products you don’t usually find elsewhere.

The staff is polite, knowledgeable, and always ready to guide you in finding the right products. I especially love their gifting section — beautifully packed hampers that make celebrations extra special.

Overall, a wonderful shopping experience every time. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality products and a premium shopping feel.”

Can be made plain or like a pulao with lots of veggies or like a stir fry fried rice.
Best way to incorporate millets in our diet !

featured_reviews.name: Ruchi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Homemakerz products are such a fantastic value addition to my kitchen. I love the flavours of the sauces and spices, as good as homemade. The noodles are so delicious, wholesome and healthy. I’ve been using them for a long time because I trust them for being truly organic and chemical free. And the recipes that are posted from time to time are so helpful, easy to follow and my family loves it.

featured_reviews.name: Shveta Mehra
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been using the Homemakerz preservative free sauces and salt mixes from the time that they launched them. The sauces and salt mixes are so flavourful. They make cooking easy...especially when I am time crunched and have hungry family members eagerly waiting for a snack/ meal. But when I was detected with cancer last year and my diet became restricted, their millet noodles have become my goto for all my food cravings. Since I have dietary restrictions, I have to be very careful about preservatives and gluten. My faith in Homemakerz products is strong as I know that their ingredients are pure and safe. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I lead a healthy normal life.

featured_reviews.name: Hitakshi Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a dedicated Homemakerz customer for over 2 years now. I have PCOD and I am avoiding maida - Homemakerz noodles are the best alternative for me and save the day anytime I crave noodles. The new range of flavours make it difficult to choose from, but my and my family's favorite are Super Green Noodles and Black Pepper Noodles :)

Absolutely love this female-run business!

featured_reviews.name: Amrutha Dongray
featured_reviews.review_text: I've marinated meats & fish, made pasta with Homemakerz's salts. The results have been outstandingly flavourful every single time. Their millet noodles are a huge boon. Today, I've ordered their Rava grain noodles in quantity for my Diwali hampers. Everyone I know should be introduced to this reliable brand. Thank you Anuradha & Varsha for making cooking easy, tasty and healthy!

featured_reviews.name: Vandana Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The market is inundated with products that claim to be natural in every sense and all end up being me too versions of some factory production. Homemakerz is the one brand with a difference and one which I blindly trust. The makers have put their heart and soul into this. I love their salts, gluten free noodles and of course their most famous ‘Garam Masala’. I have stopped buying all the meat, chicken and chat masalas after getting hooked on to their Garam Masala and their various salts. The Homemakerz noodles are wonderful on the stomach and only after trying them I felt the difference between the regular maida/semolina noodles and these noodles.
My vote goes to Homemakerz.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Kashyap
featured_reviews.review_text: We have been using their sauces for the past 3 years and have found the quality to be amazing. With high quality and healthy options in offer Homemakerz is a hidden gem . Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Suzanne Freedman`
featured_reviews.review_text: Products are really tasty and so easy to use. Perfect for a young person who doesn't know or have time to cook from scratch. Definitely recommend them, taste bhi, health bhi 😉

featured_reviews.name: Sampath Iyengarr
featured_reviews.review_text:
Convenient and Well-Stocked – Star Bazaar, Andheri West

Star Bazaar Andheri West has become a great spot for everyday shopping. Free parking is now available, and they’ve added more checkout counters, so billing is much faster. The non-fresh grocery section is well-stocked with a wide variety of products.

Their fresh fruits and vegetables are best picked up around 9 AM — it’s less crowded and everything is newly stocked. The store is very close to DN Nagar Metro Station, making it super accessible.

They also offer a mobile app for easy home delivery of groceries. One small downside — mobile signal inside the store is a bit weak, so keep that in mind if you’re trying to coordinate or pay via UPI.

Still, overall, a very convenient and dependable store in the area!

featured_reviews.name: Beauty Zone
featured_reviews.review_text:
Star Bazaar in Andheri West is hands down one of the best hypermarkets in the locality.
2 The very first thing you notice when you walk in is how beautifully clean and hygienic the entire place is. Their fresh produce section is undoubtedly the biggest highlight of this outlet.
2 You can find an immense variety of fresh fruits and vegetables that look like they were just picked from the farm The leafy vegetables are kept well-hydrated, crisp, and completely free from dirt. It is the perfect place for families looking to stock up on bulk groceries while keeping expenses low. They maintain multiple active billing counters, which helps in managing the crowd and speeding up the checkout process.

featured_reviews.name: Tweetu Piyudi
featured_reviews.review_text:
● The entry has been shifted to the right, which is inconvenient since the mall entrance is still on the left.
● The staff at the entry counter insisted on keeping my empty bag with them instead of simply locking it, which wasted my time. I prefer transferring groceries directly into my big bag at the billing counter, but now I have to move them twice....first to their cart, then from cart to my bag.
● The dry fruits counter is almost always unattended. In my last three visits, no one was there. I end up skipping purchases worth around ₹2k each time. clearly their loss.
● The newly arranged checkout counters are inconvenient and poorly visible. Most people don’t even realize there are 2nd and 3rd counters in the same row.
● The new billing staff are super slow and seem unskilled to handle large crowds efficiently.
● More than half of the billing counters are closed.
● The bazaar has gone from good to worst in the last few years ever since they shifted the entrance. The floors are dirty. Flour section was a complete mess.
●Kindly bring back the old star bazaar management idk. Just make it awesome again.  🙏 We are locals and we know when the bar is going downwards.  The fall.
